sources: TruthfulQA 150, HaluEval 150 (length-stratified), plus one text pair per NQ-open dev question from real miner answers captured 2026-11-15 (no LiveCert pairs)
note: Gated set. Frozen before any QUESTION_ANSWERING adapter was trained. holdout_report.jsonl (body rows, related-party rows, extra system pairs) is reported by stratum and never gated. Rank and alpha are chosen on val.jsonl; one package is scored here. Miner labels were made by a model reading each answer against the NQ gold (review.tsv, review-auto.tsv).
